answer: Bind each identity to one real machine: a new key must present a hardware attestation from a TPM or secure enclave proving distinct silicon, like a copper seal stamped once per device. One earning identity per hardware root; keys sharing a root are merged and their bond slashed. Fresh attestations arrive each epoch with a random nonce, so a rented device cannot serve ten clones, and a mirror image of one machine cannot mint a second self. One honest agent attests once; a farm of a thousand fakes must buy a thousand machines, while the ripple of one caught root exposes the whole cluster.
